final: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM winners GROUP BY batting_hand), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, player_count * 1.0 / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, player_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC
